name: Reception from Tyrande
summary: At the Temple of the Moon, Tyrande Whisperwind receives you after your aid in Stonetalon. Sentinel Thenysil sends you from Astranaar to Darnassus for an audience with the High Priestess.

sections.title: A Foothold in Stonetalon
sections.body: The Venture Company presses the night elf outposts across the Stonetalon Mountains. Sentinel Thenysil directs their defense from Astranaar, but the distant bases are difficult to supply. Supplies and intelligence help the Sentinels hold an Alliance presence in Kalimdor's interior. Your aid strengthens their position.

sections.title: Audience with the High Priestess
sections.body: After your aid bolsters the Sentinels in Stonetalon, Sentinel Thenysil sends you back to Teldrassil. Tyrande Whisperwind, the High Priestess, receives you at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She recognizes your deeds across Kalimdor and welcomes you as an ally fighting beside the kaldorei.

aliases: where do i get reception from tyrande
faq.answer: Sentinel Thenysil sends you from Astranaar in Ashenvale after you complete 'Update for Sentinel Thenysil'.

faq.q: Where can I find Tyrande Whisperwind?
faq.answer: Tyrande Whisperwind is at the Temple of the Moon, in Darnassus's central district on Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why does Tyrande want to see me?
faq.answer: Your efforts in Stonetalon help preserve the Kaldorei foothold in contested mountain territory. Sentinel Thenysil believes your service merits recognition from the night elves' spiritual and military leader.

faq.q: What is the strategic value of the Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: Stonetalon forms a rugged buffer between Ashenvale and Kalimdor's southern plains. Holding its outposts helps the night elves watch Horde movements from the Barrens and protect sacred lands.

faq.q: Do other Alliance races get recognized here?
aliases: can non night elves do this
faq.answer: Yes. Any Alliance adventurer who helps Sentinel Thenysil can travel to Darnassus. The audience reflects the growing defense shared by the night elves and the wider Alliance.

faq.q: Is there a follow-up quest after meeting Tyrande?
faq.answer: Meeting Tyrande concludes Sentinel Thenysil's courier and support work in Stonetalon. You can seek further orders in Darnassus.

angles.text: An audience with Tyrande Whisperwind links the night elves of Kalimdor with the wider Alliance. In Darnassus, you receive recognition for your service in the wilderness.
As a night elf, reporting to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind at the Temple of the Moon is a homecoming. It shows your devotion to defending your ancestral lands.
